services.name: Space Rental
services.desc: ACA has spaces available throughout our facility that community members can rent for a variety of uses! We charge an hourly fee for the use of our spaces and have a range of furniture pieces and audio/video tools available for use in these spaces. Whatever event or meeting you may have, we likely have a space to accommodate your needs! Arlington Center for the Arts rents our Shaira Ali Gallery + Performance Space for visual & performing arts related activities as well as community events. services.name: Past Exhibits
services.desc: Teen Perspectives on Immigration is a collection of student art and essays inspired by the theme, “How My Community Benefits from Immigration” which was submitted for The Immigrant Learning Center’s 2026 Teen Perspectives Art & Essay Contest. Each year, The Immigrant Learning Center invites students from Everett, Malden and Medford public high schools to honor the contributions immigrates have made - and continue to make - to our country and to local communities. In 2026 we received more than 80 submissions ranging from personal immigration stories to reflections on living in immigrant-rich cities. The winning entries are on display.
